title: Phalaenopsis Orchid Cultivation: Why Glass Greenhouses Outperform Polyhouses in Tropical Production
excerpt: Phalaenopsis orchids are among the most climate-sensitive ornamental crops in commercial floriculture. This article explains why glass greenhouse systems consistently outperform polyhouses for Phalaenopsis cultivation by examining plant physiology, epiphytic root biology, structural design, and climate-control precision. Drawing on global production practices and Indian growing conditions, the article establishes that glass greenhouses are not an optional upgrade but a biological necessity for consistent, premium-grade Phalaenopsis production
